params.body:
Rendering one report page takes about two seconds on the server. Without this, the first subscriber to open a new report, or a new version of a PDF, waited for every page they turned.

- **`gentells:render-report-pages`** renders the pages that are missing for every deliverable report, through the same `PageRenderer` the reading room uses. It runs every five minutes, in the background, without overlapping. When all pages exist it does nothing.
- **A new PDF** has a new modification time, so it gets a new folder and is rendered again.
- **`PageRenderer::exists()`** answers whether a page of the current PDF is ready. The path is built in one place.

On 1 October the three published reports were rendered by hand on the server: 72 pages in about 100 seconds. From now on this happens by itself.

Tests: 345 passing. The new test checks that the task renders all pages once and does nothing on the second run.
params.title: Report pages are ready before the first reader opens them
